skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Synthesize knowledge from the training program to identify theoretical and practical issues in the field of economic resources.
Identify appropriate policies to explain situations and apply them in practice.
Propose solutions for existing problems at the workplace.
Select and apply appropriate research methods and techniques.
Demonstrate critical thinking in analyzing and evaluating issues.
Show initiative in learning, researching, and working independently.
Write comprehensive reports on research findings.
Effectively present research findings in a clear and organized manner.
